item.title: Kamakura Great Buddha Guide: Kotoku-in, Hase & Access
item.description: The serene, weathered Great Buddha of Kamakura (Kamakura Daibutsu) is one of Japan’s most iconic sights — a colossal 13th-century bronze statue of Amida Buddha sitting peacefully in the open air at Kotoku-in temple. Once housed in a great hall that was washed away by a tsunami, the 11.3-metre figure has gazed over the seaside town for some 750 years. Together with the flower-filled Hase-dera temple nearby, it anchors a wonderful half-day in the historic former capital of Kamakura, an easy and rewarding day trip from Tokyo and Yokohama.
